usage: Onion is a commonly used vegetable with a slightly pungent taste.
When buying onions, choose ones with a dry surface and no damage.
Onions can be stir-fried, cooked, or eaten raw.
When cutting onions, it’s easy to tear up because they release irritating gases.
Onions can enhance the depth of flavour in dishes.
